title: HELLO2 line carrying a mirrorRef, claimedPeerId, public key SPKI and nonce
notes: One WebSocket TEXT message, no terminator (SCHEMA.md §Kinds handshake-text). Pins only the HELLO2 TEXT GRAMMAR ([DSC1-HELLO-*], decision ncz.5-D1: cryptographic binding is out of scope here) — that encodeHello2 renders four space-separated base64url tokens after the HELLO2 prefix and that parseHello2 of the line round-trips to the same Hello2 fields. Signature/nonce validity is DSC1's own concern (HelloProtocolTest, WsAuthenticatedHelloTest), not this vector's. mirrorRef, claimedPeerId, publicKeySpki and nonce are synthetic constants, not a real keypair's (decision ncz.5-D6): publicKeySpki is the 12-byte Ed25519 SubjectPublicKeyInfo prefix followed by raw bytes 0x01..0x20 (44 bytes); claimedPeerId is `ed25519:` + unpadded base64url of SHA-256 over those 44 SPKI bytes — a key-derived SHAPE only, whose equality with civictech.identity.fingerprint's own minting is deliberately unverified (ncz.5-D1); nonce is bytes 0x10..0x2F (32 bytes, HELLO_NONCE_BYTES). All base64url tokens are unpadded per RFC 4648 §5, matching what encodeHello2 emits.
